title: Palmistry for All
author: Cheiro (Count Louis Hamon)
used_for: What each principal line is traditionally linked with and promises (head: mentality; life: vitality; heart: emotional nature and affection; fate: the direction of a career; sun: success, recognition and ease) and the method of comparing the two hands (one hand inherited, the other developed). The book also makes claims about health, length of life, accidents and dated events. This knowledge base leaves those claims out on purpose.

title: Palm Reading: A Comprehensive Guide to Unlocking the Secrets of Your Hand
author: HowStuffWorks
used_for: The four hand shapes named for the elements, and the idea that the dominant and non-dominant hands are read differently. The article describes the fire hand as square with short fingers, where most other sources use a long palm, so the details of the scheme differ between sources.

title: Palmistry Hand Shapes: Earth, Air, Fire, and Water Hands
author: Palmistry Path (no author shown)
used_for: The scheme this project uses for the four hand shapes: a square palm with short fingers is earth, square with long is air, long with long is water, long with short is fire. Palm shape is judged as roughly square or rectangular and finger length against the palm.

title: Palmistry
author: Wikipedia
used_for: The names of the lines, and the statements that palmistry is widely viewed as a pseudoscience and that its interpretations contradict one another.
